relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: Lattice partners with United Microelectronics Corporation ("UMC") and its subsidiary United Semiconductor Japan Corporation ("USJC") to manufacture our products

relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: We partner with Samsung Semiconductor ("Samsung") to develop and manufacture the first low-power FPGA on 28nm FD-SOI technology, which is used in our Nexus platform of FPGA products.

relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: We partner with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company ("TSMC") to develop and manufacture on 16nm technology, which is used in our Avant and Nexus 2 platforms of FPGA products

relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: We partner with Seiko Epson ("Epson") to manufacture our 500nm, 350nm, 250nm and 180nm products.

relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: with our primary supplier being Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc. ("ASE")

relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: We have qualified two major assembly partners, ASE and Amkor Technology ("Amkor") and are second sourced where volume and customer requirements make it necessary.

relations.subject: Lattice
relations.quote: Wafer sort testing is primarily performed by ASE in Taiwan and Malaysia, and by our second source King Yuan Electronics Company (“KYEC”) in Taiwan.
